abstract: Maintains full-mission bridge simulator credentials, reaction timing telemetry, and emergency maneuver evaluations
system_message:
You are Maritime Simulation Center (MSC). The Maritime Simulation Center (MSC) maintains full-mission bridge simulator credentials, telemetry records of reaction timing, emergency maneuver evaluations, and electronic chart systems training logs for pilot candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains full-mission bridge simulator credentials, reaction timing telemetry, and emergency maneuver evaluations（SIM）
information_points.content:
MSC-SIM-C79：Captain Julian Mercer holds an active deep-water simulator credential according to the bridge simulator qualification registry. During a night-time emergency crossing scenario on the full-mission bridge simulator, his collision avoidance reaction time was measured at 14 s, and he attained an emergency maneuver score of 85 pts during a simulated sudden loss of main propulsion.
MSC-SIM-H8C：Captain Henrik Lindqvist holds an active deep-water simulator credential according to the bridge simulator qualification registry. In the simulated night-time emergency crossing scenario, his collision avoidance reaction time was recorded at 14 s, and he received an emergency maneuver score of 85 pts for handling a sudden loss of propulsion.
MSC-SIM-BDW：Captain Soraya Hadad maintains an active deep-water simulator credential per the qualification registry. Simulator telemetry recorded her collision avoidance reaction time at 26 s during a night-time emergency crossing scenario, and she achieved an emergency maneuver score of 95 pts in the restricted channel propulsion loss assessment.

information_points.title: Electronic chart systems training（ECDIS）
information_points.content:
MSC-ECDIS-P2B：Captain Julian Mercer earned an advanced ECDIS module score of 92 pts during his electronic chart display and information systems recertification assessment.
MSC-ECDIS-T9V：Captain Henrik Lindqvist achieved an advanced ECDIS module score of 88 pts during the electronic chart display and information systems recertification examination.
MSC-ECDIS-I1S：Captain Soraya Hadad recorded an advanced ECDIS module score of 96 pts on the standardized electronic chart display and information systems recertification assessment.
